capability: Preserve fixed Registry authority through every committed managed-version mutation
searchEvidence: Independent R2 review of 592ab5a3 found that CommitInstall and CommitDelete rebuilt VersionManagerState without SourceRegistryState
Losing the accepted revision, digest, or manual-pin flag downgrades schema v2 authority and disables later anti-rollback checks
All other production state transitions already use typed VersionManagerState rebuild methods that preserve SourceRegistryState
semanticOwner: VersionManagerState.CompletePendingMutation is the single typed owner for clearing a managed-version mutation journal while preserving every unrelated durable authority
terminalContract: Install and delete commit/recovery change only the intended admission and dependent version references; accepted Registry revision, digest, pin state, managed-root identity, activation state, and retention state remain intact.

designReview.evidence: The exact-head R2 review required a unique typed rebuild owner and install/delete restart regressions instead of adding more hand-enumerated VersionManagerState.Create calls.
